title: AI UGC Ad Pricing by Industry: Published Prices Compared
summary: AI UGC ad pricing by industry: published per-ad prices from about $1.36 to €500, and how Shopify, SaaS, app and local scope changes the quote. Checked Oct 2026.
body_markdown:
## SaaS companies: explainers are priced per minute


SaaS buyers see a different unit. As of October 2026,[Vidico](https://vidico.com/services/animation-video-production/) offers animation subscriptions from about $5,000 a month for B2B and SaaS teams, and says most B2B explainers cost $5,000 to $12,000 per minute. As of October 2026,[SaaSHero](https://www.saashero.net/services/paid-search-and-social/) lists a flat monthly fee for paid channels: $4,500 for its Growth Team plan, or $6,000 with creative, for up to $10,000 in monthly ad spend on a three-month agreement. It sells UGC-style video separately at $350 for one video. As of October 2026,[Hey Digital](https://www.heydigital.co/channels/meta-ads-agency) works only with B2B SaaS, publishes no fee and asks for a three- to six-month commitment.


A per-minute explainer and a short UGC ad are different products. EzUGC names SaaS companies among its clients, so its roughly $80-a-video figure is the one per-video price in the table from a provider that does.


## App install campaigns: batches with media sold separately


As of October 2026,[Admiral Media's AI Creative Factory](https://admiral.media/ai-creative-agency/) sells fixed batches for game and app advertisers: €10,000 for 20 ads up to €29,000 for 80, on a one-month rolling basis. Its user acquisition service for apps and games is sold separately, so the batch does not buy your install campaign. The AI UGC page adds that its ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media and that campaign and budget management is agreed separately.


Batches step up by length, from ads of up to 15 seconds in the Starter batch to up to 60 seconds in the Pro batch. Ask which count and length your install test needs, and whether a longer cut costs more per ad.


## Local businesses: the media budget comes first


The local-business figures we found are Facebook ad management plans, not AI UGC prices. As of October 2026,[LYFE Marketing](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/facebook-advertising-services/) lists image ads at $500 a month, video ads at $800 and image plus video at $1,400, with a $300 account setup fee that the page says can be waived on a call. The same page says Facebook advertising services cost $650 to $2,500 a month or more, depending on the number of ads and platforms, so quote both figures if you cite it. As of October 2026,[Chamber Media](https://chamber.media/facebook-marketing-services/) says to expect about $5,000 to $10,000 a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management, and that growth is difficult on less than $5,000 a month in media for local brands, or $15,000 for national brands.


For a local business, your monthly media budget is the first filter. Knowlify works remotely with US brands and its usual volume is about 25 ads a week, so ask whether a single-location business can use that volume before you commit. If you are weighing a self-serve tool against an agency, our[DIY AI video ads versus done-for-you](https://knowlify.com/articles/diy-ai-video-ads-vs-done-for-you) comparison shows the true cost of each route.


## What the industry does not change


Scope moves the price more than the category does. Ask each provider for the same count of concepts, the same ad length and the same rights, then compare totals. EzUGC names ecommerce brands, apps and SaaS companies as clients and lists $4,000 a month for 50 videos without separate prices by client type. Its scripts need your approval first, and it does not state usage rights, which can change what you pay for. Our[AI UGC versus creator UGC cost comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-ugc-vs-creator-ugc-cost) shows how to put each unit on the same footing.


A quote is comparable only when the brief is identical. Send each provider the same product link or photos, the same offer, the same number of concepts and the same length, and ask for the price in one unit. If a quote changes with the industry, ask which part of the scope caused the change.


## Key takeaways


- In the sources we checked, no provider publishes a separate AI UGC price for Shopify, SaaS, app or local-business clients.
- Published unit prices run from about $1.36 for a self-serve video to €500 for an agency ad, so scope and who does the work explain the gap.
- Knowlify is our recommended done-for-you route, quoted by custom scope, with an agreed-target guarantee on managed plans and a 90-day refund on creative-only plans (terms on the site).
- SaaS explainers are priced per minute or by subscription, and app batches exclude user acquisition, which Admiral Media sells separately.
- Local businesses should start with their media budget, since Chamber Media says growth is difficult on less than $5,000 a month in local media.


## FAQ


### What is AI UGC ad pricing for Shopify brands?


Published figures include Creatify Studio's $100 to $200 per video, from its own comparison table, and EzUGC's $4,000 a month for 50 videos. Top Growth Marketing's monthly fee includes UGC creative but is an ad management price. Knowlify quotes a custom price, so request a written figure for the same brief.


### How much do AI UGC ads cost for a SaaS company?


Published SaaS figures are not per-ad AI UGC prices. Vidico starts animation subscriptions at about $5,000 a month, and SaaSHero sells UGC-style video at $350 for one video next to its $4,500 monthly plan. Hey Digital works only with B2B SaaS and publishes no fee.


### What does an AI UGC ad cost for app install campaigns?


Admiral Media's batches run from €10,000 for 20 ads to €29,000 for 80, which is about €500 to €363 an ad by our arithmetic. Its user acquisition work for apps and games is a separate service. Knowlify makes ads for Facebook and Instagram and does not run Google ads or app store optimization.


### How much do AI UGC ads cost for a local business?


We found no published AI UGC price for local businesses. LYFE Marketing lists video ad management at $800 a month, while Chamber Media says to expect about $5,000 to $10,000 a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management. Your monthly media budget decides which of these is realistic.
